title: [교외행사] The 8th China International College Students` "Internet+" Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition
contentHtml:
The 8th China International College Students` "Internet+" Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition

Yanbian University(in China) sincerely invite you to participate in The 8th China International College Students` "Internet+" Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition.

 China International College Students' "Internet+" Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition has been held for seven sessions since 2015. Participated by 25.33  million college students in 6.03 million teams from 121 countries and regions in five continents, the competition has become the largest global event for innovation and entrepreneurship. The 8th China International College Students' "Internet+" Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition will be held in 2022. We invite excellent young people engaged in innovation and entrepreneurship all over the world to this event where entrants can work to realize the dream of innovation and entrepreneurship, and to create a better future for the world.

 We hope you will read the Notice to International Entrants in Annex 1. If you are interested in participating in this competition, please fill in the application form in Annex 2 and send the form to this email before June 9. Thank you.

 If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

 Kind regards,

 Hailin Cui
